title: Field-Oriented Current Controller
text: Implement current control for three-phase motors using field-oriented control (FOC) technique, 7 inputs, 2 outputs, {Input electrical position unit} sets Unit of electrical position input; {Number of data points for sine-cosine lookup table} sets the size of lookup table array, {Alpha (phase-a) axis alignment} sets the dq reference frame, {Saturation method} and {PWM method} sets the modulation technique SVM: space vector. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: I dqRef
ports.summary: Reference d - and q -axis currents vector

ports.name: I abMeas
ports.summary: Measured phase a and b currents vector

ports.name: V SatLim
ports.summary: Saturation limit of d-q voltages scalar

ports.name: K p,K i *T s
ports.summary: d - and q -axis PI controller gains vector

ports.name: PI Config
ports.summary: Initial values and limits of the PI controller output vector

params.name: Input electrical position unit
params.values: Unit of electrical position input Radians (default) | Degrees | Per-unit

params.name: Number of data points for sine-cosine lookup table
params.values: Size of lookup table array 1024 (default) | scalar in the range [125, 4095]

params.name: Alpha (phase-a) axis alignment
params.values: dq reference frame alignment D-axis (default) | Q-axis

params.name: Saturation method
params.values: Saturation method used by block D-Q equivalence (default) | Prioritize D axis | Prioritize Q axis

params.name: PWM method
params.values: Modulation technique SVM: space vector modulation (default) | SPWM: sinusoidal PWM
